name: Mirai no Uta to, Tsunagaru Hitomi
original_name: 未来の歌と、つながるヒトミ
source:
Our first encounter was terrible. Our meeting is terrible each time. Our conversation is terrible each time.
You and me.
If we hadn't known each other, we wouldn't have changed.

However, we learned that:

It's more fun to be two of us.
The music can cross the line between a man and a non-human.
New sound appears from our encounter.
The more we know about each other, the tighter our bond becomes.

New "song" created by two binds us together and spreads to the world...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ054062.html/?locale=en_US]English DLsite[/url]]

Another Vocaloid visual novel from Supplement Time. This one was released at Comiket 76.
translation:
我们的初次邂逅糟透了。此后的每次见面都很糟，每次交谈也同样糟糕。
你和我。
如果不曾相识，我们就不会改变。

然而，我们明白了：

两个人在一起更加快乐。
音乐能够跨越人与非人之间的界线。
新的声音因我们的相遇而诞生。
对彼此了解得越多，我们的羁绊便越牢固。

由二人共同创作的全新“歌曲”将我们紧紧相连，并传向世界……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ054062.html/?locale=en_US]English DLsite[/url]]

Supplement Time制作的又一部VOCALOID视觉小说，于Comic Market 76发布。
